description: How could Penn State officials fail to act after being told Jerry Sandusky was molesting young boys? Institutions do a bad job of policing themselves.
shortAnswer: Criminal charges alone are not enough. Our civil justice system is designed to mete out punishment to wrongdoers, make those who enable abusers pay for the harm they have done, and send a signal to other top school officials that they better get sex criminals off the campus and turned in to the police.

faq.q: Will the Penn State child sexual abuse scandal lead to lawsuits?
faq.a: The Penn State scandal is sure to result in lawsuits that last for years to come.
